measured.method: Original source boxes; skin ramp at iris row, bridged across recorded eye/sclera pixels. Min/median/max; ratio = median(gap or leading iris margin / face_w). Unresolved/occluded or non-warm samples excluded from spacing fit only. Fixtures match the original PIPOYA/knight PNGs.

front.anchor: cx = integer pixel centre between eye groups (normal x=16); ey = top iris row (normal y=13); +x right, +y down; suffix -l/-r denotes image left/right

source.how: Replace only the image-left 3x5 opening with skin and a three-pixel closed lid; keep the other extracted eye.
Replace only the image-right 3x5 opening with skin and a three-pixel closed lid; keep the other extracted eye.
Keep the 3x5 footprint and 1x2 pupil; replace lower iris with sclera and add a rounded lower lid for a wide opening.
Erase the 3x5 iris with s and bend the three-pixel lid upward into a closed smiling arc; mirror the second arc.
Cover only the image-left 3x5 opening with a p patch; keep the image-right eye normal.
Cover only the image-right 3x5 opening with a p patch; keep the image-left eye normal.
Replace a one-pixel diagonal through the image-left eye with c; retain the iris and other eye.
Replace a one-pixel diagonal through the image-right eye with c; retain the iris and other eye.
Remove the image-left iris, close its lid and add a one-pixel c scar; retain the image-right normal eye.
Remove the image-right iris, close its lid and add a one-pixel c scar; retain the image-left normal eye.
Keep the extracted eye geometry unchanged while the eat mouth supplies the chewing expression; no original chewing animation is present.
Keep the original absent brow for closed; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for wink-l; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for wink-r; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Add three l pixels sloping toward the bridge above each extracted eye; originals show angled lids but no separate angry brow.
Raise a three-pixel l brow above each widened eye; no original raised surprised brows are present.
Keep the original absent brow for happy; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for patch-l; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for patch-r; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for scar-l; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for scar-r; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for one-eyed-l; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for one-eyed-r; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for eat; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the extracted dark mouth contour and replace two interior chewing pixels by t; no original eating construction is present.

left.anchor: cx = skin-region centre (normal x=16); ey = top iris row (normal y=13); one visible eye; source variants preserve offsets from their own cx, ey

source.how: Replace the visible 3x5 eye by skin and the same three-pixel raised closed arc; do not add a far eye.
Cover the one visible 3x5 eye with p; leave the omitted far eye absent.
Keep the extracted eye geometry unchanged while the eat mouth supplies the chewing expression; no original chewing animation is present.
Keep the original absent brow for closed; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Add three l pixels sloping toward the visible eye; no separate angry side brow is visible in the originals.
Keep the original absent brow for happy; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for patch; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the original absent brow for eat; the eye or mouth carries this expression.
Keep the extracted dark mouth contour and replace two interior chewing pixels by t; no original eating construction is present.
